headline: Board to review KPMG audit presentation, August FY27 financials, and a general manager update.
summary: The meeting covers a KPMG audit presentation with discussion and vote, a monthly impact minute, a general manager update, and a review of August FY27 financials.
items: KPMG Audit Presentation (Expected Executive Session), Discussion and Vote: Amanda Hurlbut, Controller; Jeffrey Koch, KPMG; Jake Day, KPMG
location: Burlington Electric Department, 585 Pine Street, Burlington, Vermont 05401 (also via Microsoft Teams)
